name: enlarge/reduce
lore:
### On the Transmutation of Scale: Enlarge/Reduce

To cast *Enlarge/Reduce* is to grasp the very threads of spatial reality and stretch them like sun-warmed wax. When drawing upon the Weave, the practitioner feels a peculiar, elastic tension—a phantom resistance that snaps into a heavy, grounding thrum for growth, or a light, effervescent prickling for diminution.

Visually, the target is briefly enveloped in a shimmering, amber distortion, as if viewed through thick, rippling glass. Objects groan with the sudden expansion of their fibers, or whistle as displaced air rushes to fill the void of their shrinking. 

Legend attributes this formula to the Gnomish Archmage, Pip the Pint-Sized. Weary of being overlooked at the Great Conclave of Oakhaven, Pip did not merely stand on a chair; he wove a spell that saw him tower over the High Elves, his voice booming like mountain thunder. Conversely, when the palace guards attempted to seize him, he vanished into a mouse-hole, leaving only a tiny, mocking laugh behind.

Take heed, traveler: while the body may wax or wane, the soul remains the same size, regardless of the vessel’s shadow.
